name: Uptime Kuma
description: A self-hosted uptime and status-page monitor for websites and services.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"

name: Miniflux
description: A minimalist RSS/Atom feed reader that requires a PostgreSQL database and starts with a default admin login you should change immediately.
compose:
services:
  miniflux:
    image: miniflux/miniflux:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:8080"
    depends_on:
      - db
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://miniflux:secret@db/miniflux?sslmode=disable
      - RUN_MIGRATIONS=1
      - CREATE_ADMIN=1
      - ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
      - ADMIN_PASSWORD=test123
  db:
    image: postgres:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=miniflux
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret
      - POSTGRES_DB=miniflux
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/postgresql

name: IT-Tools
description: A collection of handy browser-based utilities for developers, with no persistent data of its own.
compose:
services:
  it-tools:
    image: corentinth/it-tools:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"

name: Jellyfin
description: A free media server for streaming movies, shows, and music from your own library to any device.
compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./cache:/cache
      - ./media:/media

name: Navidrome
description: A music streaming server that indexes your personal audio library behind a Subsonic-compatible web interface.
compose:
services:
  navidrome:
    image: deluan/navidrome:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "4533:4533"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./music:/music:ro

name: qBittorrent
description: A BitTorrent client with a web interface; the image defaults to a non-root user, so the config directory may need its ownership adjusted before it can write.
compose:
services:
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - WEBUI_PORT=8081
      - TORRENTING_PORT=6881
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./downloads:/downloads
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6882:6881/udp"

name: Node-RED
description: A flow-based tool for wiring together IoT and home-automation devices and APIs; the image runs as uid 1000, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  node-red:
    image: nodered/node-red:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "1880:1880"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Paperless-ngx
description: A document scanner and archive that OCRs and tags paperwork, run here with SQLite and a Valkey broker instead of PostgreSQL.
compose:
services:
  broker:
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:9-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./redisdata:/data
  webserver:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - broker
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - ./media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://broker:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBENGINE=sqlite

name: Trilium Notes
description: A hierarchical personal notes app with rich formatting; the image runs as a non-root node user, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  trilium:
    image: triliumnext/notes:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TRILIUM_DATA_DIR=/home/node/trilium-data
    ports:
      - "8082:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./trilium-data:/home/node/trilium-data

name: Gitea
description: A lightweight self-hosted Git service using SQLite, no external database needed; the image defaults to uid 1000, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: docker.gitea.com/gitea:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./gitea:/data
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - "2222:22"

name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: A reverse proxy with a web UI for issuing TLS certificates and routing traffic to other self-hosted apps by domain name.
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8880:80"
      - "8443:443"
      - "81:81"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt

name: Homepage
description: A customizable start-page dashboard that links out to your self-hosted services; set HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS to the address you browse it from.
compose:
services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3030:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/app/config
    environment:
      - HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost:3030

name: Nextcloud
description: A self-hosted file sync and collaboration platform, run here with its community-maintained image and default SQLite database.
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: nextcloud:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8083:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/html

name: Syncthing
description: A peer-to-peer file synchronization tool with no central server; the image runs as uid 1000, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  syncthing:
    image: syncthing/syncthing:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    hostname: syncthing
    ports:
      - "8384:8384"
      - "22000:22000"
      - "22001:22000/udp"
      - "21027:21027/udp"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/syncthing

name: Duplicati
description: A backup client that encrypts and uploads files to local or cloud storage, with its web UI unlocked by a token from the container logs.
compose:
services:
  duplicati:
    image: duplicati/duplicati:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8200:8200"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Vaultwarden
description: A lightweight, Bitwarden-compatible password manager server; disable SIGNUPS_ALLOWED once your own account exists.
compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=true
    ports:
      - "8087:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Actual Budget
description: A local-first personal budgeting app with a web UI for tracking accounts and transactions.
compose:
services:
  actual:
    image: actualbudget/actual-server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5006:5006"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Linkding
description: A minimalist bookmark manager with tagging and full-text search; change the default admin credentials after first login.
compose:
services:
  linkding:
    image: sissbruecker/linkding:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/etc/linkding/data
    environment:
      - LD_SUPERUSER_NAME=admin
      - LD_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=changeme

name: ntfy
description: A pub-sub notification service for pushing alerts to phones and desktops over HTTP.
compose:
services:
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - serve
    ports:
      - "8085:80"
    volumes:
      - ./cache:/var/cache/ntfy

name: Portainer
description: A web UI for managing Docker containers, images, and volumes; it requires access to the host's Docker socket to work at all.
compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9443:9443"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock

name: Vikunja
description: A self-hosted to-do and project manager; the image runs as uid 1000 and won't chown its own mounts, so the files and db directories need matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  vikunja:
    image: vikunja/vikunja:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - VIKUNJA_SERVICE_SECRET=changeme-generate-a-real-secret
      - VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL=http://localhost:3456/
    ports:
      - "3456:3456"
    volumes:
      - ./files:/app/vikunja/files
      - ./db:/db

name: Grafana
description: A dashboarding and visualization tool for metrics and logs; the image runs as a non-root uid, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3300:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/grafana

name: PhotoPrism
description: An AI-powered photo manager that indexes and tags a personal photo library, using SQLite when no external database is configured.
compose:
services:
  photoprism:
    image: photoprism/photoprism:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "2342:2342"
    environment:
      - PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD=changeme123
    volumes:
      - ./originals:/photoprism/originals
      - ./storage:/photoprism/storage

name: Mealie
description: A recipe manager and meal planner with a web UI; the image defaults to a non-root uid, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  mealie:
    image: ghcr.io/mealie-recipes/mealie:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9925:9000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data/

name: FreshRSS
description: A lightweight self-hosted RSS/Atom feed aggregator with a web UI and a built-in SQLite database.
compose:
services:
  freshrss:
    image: freshrss/freshrss:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8380:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/FreshRSS/data
